sourceArchive: Sega CD - Sonic the Hedgehog CD - Miscellaneous - Sound Effects (1).zip
format: Original 44.1 kHz stereo 16-bit WAV recordings, copied byte-for-byte.
selectionNote: The supplied collection deliberately identifies sounds only by sound-test number. Gameplay role names below are this games assignments, not claims about canonical sound names. FM cues only; no sampled voice lines.

samples.role: A low electronic rumble assigned to lava ignition.
A short tonal alert assigned to the last seconds of the heat countdown.
A rising electronic cue assigned to the thermal updraft launch.
A short melodic FM cue assigned to Rosies reunion; contains no invented character speech.
